Payout of 29 July is short ₹4,981.00.
The bank credited ₹53,619.94 against an expected ₹58,600.94. 15 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00005 of ₹4,981.00, raised 1 August. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00005 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00005 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
